payload.claim: binds each generated Sail definition text to its parsed AST and to the normalized observable effect of every instruction selector; it is evidence about the translation only, it is not a proof about the pinned Sail model, and it must be re-derived from the generated InstsEnd.lean on a host carrying the pinned Sail compiler before it counts as Sail evidence

normalization_rules.collapse-single-statement-do: a do-block holding exactly one expression statement denotes that expression
normalization_rules.inline-pure-let-bindings: let-bound expression names are inlined into the expressions that use them
normalization_rules.monadic-bind-is-observation: a monadic bind of a whitelisted reader denotes an observation of pre-state, never a state change
normalization_rules.next-pc-sequential-unless-set: absence of a next-pc effect denotes the sequential pc + 4 retirement
normalization_rules.register-write-via-wX_bits: wX_bits target value denotes the single architectural register write
normalization_rules.retirement-from-terminal-pure: the terminal pure expression carries the retirement classification
normalization_rules.selector-match-feeds-effect: a generated effect whose value is selected by an inline monadic match is normalized by feeding each alternative directly to that effect
normalization_rules.selector-match-is-total: the single match on the instruction selector supplies one alternative per selector and no wildcard
